domain: Offline Bitcoin-style transaction inspection before consensus authorization

scenarios.given: An ordered block of syntactically parseable synthetic transactions
scenarios.when: A bounded worker pool or serial scanner inspects the same transaction bytes
scenarios.then: TXIDs, witness hashes, candidate positions, and the complete ordered read-only report agree for supported worker and window configurations

scenarios.given: Malformed bytes, duplicate TXIDs, wrong fetched bytes, or multiple out-of-order worker failures
scenarios.then: The first canonical-position error is reported deterministically, with no partial authenticated state transition

scenarios.given: A synthetic block with external prevouts and in-block parent-child dependencies
scenarios.when: The scanner builds read-only dependency waves
scenarios.then: Waves remain deterministic, reject conflicting or invalid relationships, and preserve unknown external UTXOs

scenarios.given: An indexed block whose Bitcoin ancestry, scripts and UTXOs are unverified
scenarios.when: A caller requests authenticated consensus or signed-state authority
scenarios.then: Read-only indexing APIs reject those authority requests

scenarios.given: Pinned legacy and SegWit transaction witnesses
scenarios.when: The indexing optimization computes TXIDs and WTXIDs
scenarios.then: Outputs match independent SHA256d vectors, including non-SegWit TXID equals WTXID

limits: Acceptance only for syntactic/read-only processing of synthetic inputs.
No tested operation authenticates Bitcoin chainwork, UTXO ownership, witness scripts, consensus, wallet, or live funds.
Passing does not establish universal equivalence; add adverse counterexamples as reviewed contract cases.
Changing or weakening a contract requires a separately reviewed authority change.
